data.cultural_impact: The name "Zimr" holds a significant cultural impact as it represents a deep connection with the Islamic tradition and spiritual practices. In the Islamic faith, the act of remembering and glorifying Allah (Dhikr) is highly emphasized and considered a noble pursuit. The name Zimr can be seen as a reminder of this important practice and an inspiration to engage in it regularly.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Zimr carries immense significance as it denotes an individual who is deeply connected with Allah through the constant remembrance of His name and attributes. The person named Zimr is said to be in a state of closeness to Allah, and the name itself serves as a constant reminder of this presence and relationship. It also implies that the named person is considered worthy of remembrance by Allah Himself, making it a source of great pride and inspiration.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidāyah wa'l-Nihāyah (The Beginning and the End) - Volume 10, Page 328-329 The name Zimr carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mention of Zimr ibn Salih Al-Aqdi as the leader of the Yemeni army, who was defeated by the Mongols in the Battle of Aden. He was a descendant of Prophet Salih (as).
